hypothesis: A candidate number's membership pattern across the two immediately preceding main draws (absent from both, present only two draws back, present only the latest draw, or present in both) may provide cutoff-safe conditional information about inclusion in the next main draw. One fixed four-state estimator may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null.
question: Does one frozen two-draw membership-state conditional inclusion estimator improve a three-line disjoint union18 portfolio on targets 401..1250 under the unchanged four-metric strict gate?

feature_definition.source: The two immediately preceding draws' six main numbers only; bonus numbers are excluded.

state_encoding.10: candidate present in draw t-2 and absent from draw t-1
state_encoding.11: candidate present in both draw t-2 and draw t-1
state_encoding.00: candidate absent from both draw t-2 and draw t-1
state_encoding.01: candidate absent from draw t-2 and present in draw t-1

feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=3..t-1, classify every candidate by membership in draws u-2 and u-1, then observe inclusion in draw u.

source_data_hash_scope_note: Raw canonical lotto_data.csv bytes; exactly 1,250 non-empty contiguous draw records. The full file is frozen at round 1250; no later outcome is read.
training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only draws 1..t-1. Historical transition outcomes u=3..t-1 use draws u-2 and u-1 as the two-draw membership state and draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draws t-2 and t-1, then add target t only after scoring.

estimator.prior_mean: 6/45 main-number inclusion probability under the uniform 6-of-45 null
estimator.state_definition: Two-bit presence pattern (draw t-2, draw t-1) for each candidate number.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E053 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.
portfolio.line_order: Line 1, then line 2, then line 3, each selected from the remaining unused numbers.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.
